description: List bank bonuses that were added, raised, extended or ended recently, and bonuses ending soon. Use it for 'any new bank bonuses this week', 'what changed since I last checked' or 'which bonuses end this month'. Covers the last 90 days.

kinds.description: Which changes to list. ending_soon lists bonuses whose deadline falls in the next 45 days. Defaults to all.

since.description: The first day to list, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 7 days ago; no earlier than 90 days ago.

state.description: The person's state, to list only bonuses open there.

name: whats_changed
title: New, raised and ending bank bonuses
